alt: Havnekaptajnen Docker og Bilbo Backend ser på et advarselsikon og den tidligere grønne version på en bærbar computer ved kajens syltetøjsbod.

At a low outdoor timber shipping counter extending into the dusk harbor, Bilbo stands on the quay left of a single recognizable tied blackberry jam jar and the captain, rising alongside the dock, leans down at right with his flipper directed toward their open ordinary laptop between them. A moored cargo boat with a few muted unmarked shipping containers is visible in the distance.
